identity.name: SIMPLEX CASTINGS LTD.
identity.industry: Steel & Power Equipment Manufacturing with Railway & Defense Exposure

summary.oneLiner: Simplex Castings is strategically pivoting from cyclical steel-dependent foundry to a high-margin, repetitive-product manufacturer with railway bogies and power sector fabrication as core growth engines, supported by a ₹50.15Cr fundraise to de-risk working capital and scale capacity — this shift transforms revenue visibility and margin profile for FY27 onward.

one-line thesis: Simplex Castings is strategically pivoting from cyclical steel-dependent foundry to a high-margin, repetitive-product manufacturer with railway bogies and power sector fabrication as core growth engines, supported by a ₹50.15Cr fundraise to de-risk working capital and scale capacity — this shift transforms revenue visibility and margin profile for FY27 onward.
financial scorecard: revenue: ₹150Cr (9M FY26, YoY +X%); EBITDA/margin: Soft in Q3 due to product mix, but targeted to rebound to 15%+; PAT (rptd): ₹15Cr (9M FY26); PAT (normalized): ₹13.4Cr (excl. ₹1.6Cr one-time gratuity income); order book: >₹100Cr; net debt: Net debt reduction underway via ₹25Cr working capital from fundraise, CC limit ₹34Cr from Kotak
guidance: revenue growth: Targeting 40-50% CAGR over 3 years; margin: EBITDA to improve by 2-3pp via product mix shift; order inflow: Railway casted bogies (pending RDSO sign-off), fabricated bogies (6-8mo timeline), power sector orders (BHEL/L&T pipeline), defense (3 offers pending); capex/commissioning: ₹25Cr allocated to fabrication expansion, 6-8mo timeline for fabricated bogies line
order book & pipeline: ₹100Cr+; Steel: ~50%; Power Fabrication (BHEL, Gajja Engg): ~30%; Machine Tool/Pumps: ~20%; Defense/Shipbuilding (Mazgaon Dock): ~5-6%
segment / subsidiary detail: Steel Plant Equipment: 50% order book, driven by PSU capex (ThyssenKrupp order ₹12.71Cr received); Power: 10-15% now, targeting 20-30% via 16 Adani + 22 NTPC thermal plants; Railway: Zero revenue currently, trial order for fabricated bogies, casted bogies pending RDSO clearance (FY26-27 ramp-up); Defense/Shipbuilding: Re-entered with Mazgaon Dock order (~5-6%), 3 more offers pending; Coke Oven Doors: Global market leader, high-margin niche
growth verticals / optionality: Railway bogies (₹40-50Cr revenue potential); Power sector fabrication (5L tons per plant demand); Defense/shipbuilding (high-margin); Export potential via German OEM partnerships (Claudius Peters); Aluminum foundry acquisition in discussion
margins & cost dynamics: Current EBITDA margin depressed by mix; targeted improvement to 15%+ via higher-margin products: Coke Oven Doors (monopoly), Railway Bogies (repetitive, better payment terms), Power Fabrications (design-integrated); steel orders being selectively pursued to avoid low-margin bids
capex / expansion: ₹25Cr from fundraise allocated to fabrication shed expansion for railway bogies; timeline: 6-8 months; potential Vishakapatnam unit under evaluation for ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel supply; no new foundry capex planned
capital allocation: ₹25Cr to capex (fabrication), ₹25Cr to working capital; focus on deleveraging, receivables via InvoiceMart/RXIL (TReDS); no dividends or buybacks mentioned; future M&A (aluminum foundry) under review
risks & watch-items: RDSO clearance delay for casted bogies; execution risk in scaling fabrication capacity; dependency on PSU capex timing; working capital needs beyond ₹25Cr if growth accelerates; geopolitical risk in Russia/Ukraine steel orders
management quality / tone: Confident, disciplined, and strategic — management emphasizes avoiding 2019 working capital mistakes, selective order pursuit, and long-term value creation over revenue chasing; tone is calm, focused on execution, and optimistic on railway/power growth
non-obvious takeaways: RDSO clearance for casted bogies is the single most critical near-term catalyst — once granted, it unlocks a ₹40-50Cr revenue stream with high repeat order potential; management’s 40-year Coke Oven Door tech edge is a hidden moat with global export potential
